With the launch of iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Fold just weeks away, Apple is in the thick of preparation behind the scenes. According to the latest report from Bloomberg, Apple is holding a lottery for its US retail staff, drawing names to select employees who will travel to California to help prepare for the upcoming iPhone launch event in September.

The iPhone launch event will be held in September.

The report states that Apple Store retail employees can apply to participate in the work for the iPhone launch event, where they will "help organise queues, register guests, welcome attendees, give directions, and support the security team".

Apple announced the lottery in an internal memo today, stating that the event will take place in early September.

In the memo, Apple said it was "excited to offer US store team members the opportunity to participate in the event support experience programme". Apple has relied on retail staff for years to help coordinate major product launch events. According to the memo, employees who took part in this year's Worldwide Developers Conference or last year's iPhone launch event are not eligible for the current programme. Interested employees must submit their applications by 8 August, and Apple will notify those selected by 17 August.

Apple typically holds its annual iPhone launch event in the second week of September. With US Labour Day falling on 7 September this year, Bloomberg notes that "there is a slightly higher chance the event will be held on a Wednesday, as this preserves the weekday travel window Apple has traditionally offered attendees".

If so, the iPhone launch event would take place on Wednesday, 9 September, with pre-orders expected to open that Friday and the device going on sale a week later.
